name: 21.com
note: Main Partner of Prima Pramac Yamaha MotoGP in 2026: the deal, brokered by RTR Sports Marketing (its case study), puts the brand on the bike's side fairings, riders' caps and racing suits, and the team lists 21.com as a Main Partner on its partners page (checked 2026-10-03). The current 21.com launched in June 2026 under founder and chief executive Michael Carlton and holds an Anjouan (Comoros) gaming licence (iGaming Republic, 18 June 2026); the domain previously hosted an MGA-licensed BP Group/PressEnter casino, and whether Carlton's venture acquired or rebranded that operation is unclear. Left unrated: the actual shareholding isn't sourced.
